## Highlights

Maintenance release on top of
[0.8.0](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/releases/tag/0.8.0):
a configurable DHCP lease wait for `createvm`, a dependency refresh centred
on typer 0.29, and a docs fix.

- **`createvm` waits longer for a DHCP lease, and you can tune it
    ([#169](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/issues/169)).** The
    NAT lease wait was a fixed 20 seconds, too short on slow or
    nested-virtualization hosts: `createvm` printed "No DHCP lease was
    found" and skipped the SSH hint even though the VM was fine.

    - The default wait is now **120 seconds**. It still ends as soon as the
        lease appears, so healthy hosts see no slowdown.
    - New **`--lease-timeout SECONDS`** sets it per run; `0` skips the wait.
    - New **`dhcp_lease_timeout:`** key sets it per host or per user in
        `/etc/Lvlab.yml` or `~/.Lvlab.yml`. `--lease-timeout` overrides it.
    - The wait is now bounded by elapsed time. Previously each slow
        `virsh net-dhcp-leases` call added to the advertised wait.

    ```yaml
    # ~/.Lvlab.yml on a nested-virt host
    dhcp_lease_timeout: 300
    ```

- **typer 0.27.3 → 0.29.1; typer floor raised to `>=0.29.1`.** typer
    0.29 validates CLI parameters with pydantic, so **pydantic** (and its
    compiled `pydantic-core`) is now a runtime dependency. Prebuilt wheels
    cover Python 3.11–3.14 on x86_64 and aarch64, so nothing compiles at
    install time.

- **`click` is no longer a direct dependency.** typer 0.29 vendors its
    own copy of Click, and lvlab never imports `click` itself, so the
    `click>=8.1` requirement was dropped. A fresh install no longer pulls
    in `click`.

- **Help output now labels boolean flags `<bool>`.** typer 0.29 adds a
    type label to every flag in `--help` (e.g. `--force <bool>`,
    `--all <bool>`, `--quiet <bool>`), matching the `<str>` / `<int>`
    labels options already had. This is cosmetic: flags are still passed
    without a value (`deletevm web01 --force`, not `--force true`), and
    usage lines and error messages are unchanged.

- **Install URL fixed.** The install command in `README.md` and the docs
    landing page pointed at the 0.4.0 wheel; it now points at this
    release.

- **Dev tooling:** click 8.5.0 → 8.5.1, pylint 4.1.3 → 4.1.4, pysonar
    1.10 → 1.11, zensical 0.0.73 → 0.1.2 (Dependabot #168).

## Breaking changes

None for CLI usage. If you install `tkc-lvlab` into a shared virtualenv
rather than with `uv tool install`, note that it now requires
`typer>=0.29.1` and brings in `pydantic`.

When a NAT lease never appears, `createvm` now waits up to 120 seconds
instead of 20 before printing the manual-check hint. Pass
`--lease-timeout 20` (or set `dhcp_lease_timeout: 20`) to keep the old
wait.

## Install / upgrade

```bash
uv tool install --upgrade \
  https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/releases/download/0.8.1/tkc_lvlab-0.8.1-py3-none-any.whl
```

## Supported hosts

Unchanged from 0.8.0 — Debian 12 (3.11), Debian 13 (3.13), AlmaLinux 10
(3.12), Fedora 44 (3.14). See
[`docs-extra/host-validation.md`](https://github.com/memblin/tkc-lvlab-py/blob/0.8.1/docs-extra/host-validation.md)
for the matrix.
